question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

VACANT
solution:
The correct answer is **'bare.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the word **'vacant'** is **'not filled, empty, or bare, blank.'**
 
• For example, If a cupboard or room is **bare**, there is nothing in it.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of other options.
 
 
• **Busy** - *Having a great deal to do.*
 
• **Used** - *Having already been used.*
 
• **Full **- *Having no empty space.*
